title: Bug Ledger Record
description: A deduped operational bug record kept by the bug-record company (tools/bug_record.py). This is the live detection/triage layer; a persistent, codemod-worthy entry is escalated to the richer BugRecord (bug-record.schema.json).

fingerprint.description: Stable dedup key derived from kind|path|normalized message.

kind.description: Detection class, e.g. duplicate_divergent_hook, malformed_json, unguarded_git_in_hook, log_error.

remediation.description: How it was addressed: cleared, self_heal_fix, filed_for_review, or null.
